title: The 4 Best Travel Backpacks for Carry-On Only Travel
h1: The 4 Best Travel Backpacks for Carry-On Only Travel
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for travel backpacks for carry-on only travel, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel backpacks for carry-on only travel using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Osprey Farpoint 40
products.blurb: Key specs: 40L across S/M and M/L harness sizing, Removable 11L Daylite Plus daypack, LightWire frame suspension, stows away for flights.
strengths: Clears nearly every carrier's carry-on sizer at 40L
Stowable harness means nothing snags on jet bridges or overhead bins
Removable daypack functions as a real day bag, not just a stuff sack
limitations: Fixed main compartment, no expansion for a longer trip
S/M and M/L sizing means checking your torso length before buying
Daypack attaches externally and adds bulk when both pieces are worn together
features: 40L across S/M and M/L harness sizing
Removable 11L Daylite Plus daypack
LightWire frame suspension, stows away for flights
Zip-away hipbelt and harness
Lockable dual-zip main compartment

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 42L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 42L suitcase-style full-wrap zipper opening, 1000D TPU-coated polyester shell, 840D ballistic nylon panels, Removable hip belt, air-mesh shoulder straps.
strengths: 42L is the most volume in this list while still reading as a standard carry-on
Suitcase-style opening lays flat for fast packing and security checks
Colorful, distinct designs make the bag easy to spot on a belt or overhead bin
limitations: 42L pushes past some tighter international carry-on sizers
Heavier empty weight than the Farpoint 40 due to the burly shell fabric
Fewer organizational pockets than purpose-built travel packs at this price
features: 42L suitcase-style full-wrap zipper opening
1000D TPU-coated polyester shell, 840D ballistic nylon panels
Removable hip belt, air-mesh shoulder straps
15-inch laptop sleeve and 12.5-inch tablet sleeve
Exterior stretch water bottle pocket, luggage pass-through strap

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 35L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 35L suitcase-style opening, carry-on sized, 1000D TPU-coated polyester, 100% recycled fabrics, Air-mesh back panel and removable hip belt.
strengths: 35L clears most European budget-carrier cabin limits with room to spare
Same suitcase-style layout as the 42L version in a smaller footprint
Recycled fabric build backed by a lifetime warranty
limitations: Less room than the 40L and 42L packs in this list for longer trips
Hip belt is thinner than a dedicated hiking-style harness
Fewer external quick-access pockets than the Peak Design pack
features: 35L suitcase-style opening, carry-on sized
1000D TPU-coated polyester, 100% recycled fabrics
Air-mesh back panel and removable hip belt
Exterior stretch water bottle pocket
Luggage pass-through strap

products.name: Peak Design Travel Backpack 45L
products.blurb: Key specs: Expands from 35L to 45L via external compression straps, Weatherproof 400D recycled nylon canvas shell, Rear, top, and side access with MagLatch closures.
strengths: Compresses to a smaller, stricter-sizer-friendly footprint when needed
Three separate access points make it easy to grab items without unpacking
Weatherproof shell holds up in rain at bus stops and gate walks
limitations: Tuck-away straps take a bit of practice to stow cleanly
Heavier than the Osprey Farpoint 40 when fully packed
features: Expands from 35L to 45L via external compression straps
Weatherproof 400D recycled nylon canvas shell
Rear, top, and side access with MagLatch closures
Tuck-away hip belt and sternum strap
Compatible with Peak Design packing cubes and camera cubes

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
